hooks.name: player_bed_enter
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's PlayerBedEnterEvent)

rust_summary: A player about to enter a bed, cancellable (`native_player_bed_enter`).
doc_summary: A server player about to enter a bed after its sleep checks pass: `native_player_bed_enter(player, name, pos, cancel)` hears the bed head position. Set `cancel` to keep the player out. The player's state is swapped in, though helpers that look them up through `self.lan` may find nothing during a guest packet. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_bed_enter@.
